description: Searches the website's FAQ and knowledge base articles (in Italian) about materials, finishes, print files, shipping, payments, invoices, quotes and orders. Each result: type (faq or article), title, answer (plain text, truncated to about 600 characters), url of the page on the website, and product_id for the FAQ of a product page. The content is in Italian: search with Italian words (plurals and accents are handled).

query.description: The question or the words to search for, e.g. "come preparo il file di stampa".
